scenarios.scenario: Dismiss an additional area in the temporary ribbon

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the top-docked ribbon is minimized to tabs with 3D Model active
the user clicks the 3D Model tab
the temporary command area opens
the user opens the Modify additional-command area
the additional area shows Move Bodies, Bend Part and Copy Object
the user clicks empty viewport space
the additional area and the temporary command area close
the ribbon remains minimized to tabs
the user clicks the 3D Model tab again
the temporary command area opens
the Modify additional-command area remains closed

scenarios.scenario: Switch tabs with a temporary additional area open

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the top-docked ribbon is minimized to tabs with 3D Model active
the user clicks the 3D Model tab
the user opens the Modify additional-command area
the user clicks the Tools tab
the Modify additional-command area closes
the temporary command area displays the Tools panels
the user clicks the 3D Model tab
the temporary command area displays the 3D Model panels
the Modify additional-command area remains closed

scenarios.scenario: Press Escape with an additional area open in the temporary ribbon

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the top-docked ribbon is minimized to tabs with 3D Model active
the user clicks the 3D Model tab
the user opens the Modify additional-command area
the user presses Escape twice
the temporary command area remains visible
the Modify additional-command area remains visible
the user clicks empty viewport space
both command areas close
the ribbon remains minimized to tabs

scenarios.scenario: Close a temporary expansion using its lower title

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the top-docked ribbon is minimized to tabs with 3D Model active
the user clicks the 3D Model tab
the user opens the Modify additional-command area
the user clicks the lower Modify title
the additional-command area closes
the temporary command area closes
the ribbon remains minimized to tabs

scenarios.scenario: Click the selected tab with a temporary expansion open

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the top-docked ribbon is minimized to tabs with 3D Model active
the user clicks the 3D Model tab
the user opens the Modify additional-command area
the user clicks the selected 3D Model tab
the Modify additional-command area remains visible
the temporary command area remains visible
the user clicks the selected 3D Model tab again
the additional-command area closes
the temporary command area closes
the ribbon remains minimized to tabs

scenarios.scenario: Restore the full ribbon while a temporary panel is expanded

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the ribbon is minimized to tabs
the ribbon display policy is "Minimize to Tabs"
the 3D Model tab is selected
the user clicks the 3D Model tab
its ribbon panels appear temporarily
the user opens the Modify panel's additional commands
the additional commands appear below the temporary ribbon
the user clicks the ribbon display control to restore the full ribbon
the full 3D Model ribbon is displayed
the additional commands are closed
the part remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Select a face while an unpinned panel expansion is open

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the full 3D Model ribbon is displayed
the Modify additional command area is open and unpinned
the user clicks a visible solid face outside the expanded area
the Modify additional command area closes
the clicked face is selected
the full 3D Model ribbon remains visible
the user clicks empty viewport space
the face selection is cleared

scenarios.scenario: Select a face while keyboard tips are displayed

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the full 3D Model ribbon is displayed with the Modify area closed
the user presses Alt, then M, then Y
the user clicks a visible solid face outside the expanded area
the Modify additional command area remains visible with keyboard tips displayed
the user presses Escape
the keyboard tips and Modify additional command area close
the clicked face is visibly selected
the user clicks empty viewport space
the face selection is cleared

scenarios.scenario: Select a face while a panel expansion is pinned

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the full 3D Model ribbon is displayed
the Modify additional command area is open and pinned
the user clicks a visible solid face outside the expanded area
the clicked face is selected
the Modify additional command area remains open
the full 3D Model ribbon remains visible
the user unpins the Modify additional command area
the user clicks empty viewport space
the face selection is cleared
the Modify additional command area closes

scenarios.scenario: Open a face context menu while an expansion is open

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the full 3D Model ribbon is displayed
the Modify additional command area is open and unpinned
the user right-clicks a visible solid face outside the expanded area
the face context menu is displayed
the Modify additional command area remains visible
the user presses Escape
the face context menu closes
the Modify additional command area closes
the face remains selected
the user clicks empty viewport space
the face selection is cleared

scenarios.scenario: Select a model browser feature with an unpinned expansion

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the full 3D Model ribbon has the Modify additional-command area open and unpinned
the user selects the extrusion in the model browser
the additional-command area closes
the extrusion is selected in the browser
its geometry is highlighted in the viewport

scenarios.scenario: Select a model browser feature with a pinned expansion

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the full 3D Model ribbon has the Modify additional-command area open and pinned
the user selects the extrusion in the model browser
the additional-command area remains open
the extrusion is selected in the browser
its geometry is highlighted in the viewport
the user unpins the additional-command area and clicks empty viewport space
the additional-command area closes

scenarios.scenario: Press Escape after opening the full ribbon expansion by pointer

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
the Modify additional command area is unpinned
the user clicks the Modify panel title
Move Bodies, Bend Part and Copy Object are visible in the additional area
the user presses Escape
the additional area remains visible with those commands
the user clicks the lower Modify title
the additional area closes
the full 3D Model ribbon remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Minimize to tabs after pinning the Modify expansion

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
the ribbon display policy is "Minimize to Tabs"
the user opens and pins the Modify additional command area
the user clicks empty viewport space
the Modify additional area remains visible
the user clicks the ribbon display control
the ribbon is minimized to tabs
the Modify additional area is not visible
the user clicks the 3D Model tab
the user opens the Modify additional area
the user clicks empty viewport space
the temporary ribbon and its additional command area close
the user clicks the ribbon display control to restore the full ribbon
the full 3D Model ribbon is displayed
the additional commands are closed
the user opens the Modify additional area
the user clicks empty viewport space
the additional area closes
the full 3D Model ribbon remains visible
